recipes.name: Roasted Beet Salad with Feta
ingredients_raw: 4 beets, trimmed, leaving 1 inch of stems attached

steps.text: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Wrap each beet individually in aluminum foil and place onto a baking sheet.
Roast beets in preheated oven until tender when pierced with a fork, 45 minutes to 1 hour, depending on size. Let beets cool until easy to handle; peel and slice into 1/4-inch slices.
While beets are roasting, whisk shallots, parsley, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and red wine vinegar together in a bowl until blended; season with salt and pepper and set aside.
Place warm, sliced beets onto a serving dish; pour vinaigrette over the beets and sprinkle with feta cheese.

raw_recipe.headline: Roasted Beet Salad with Feta
raw_recipe.description: This warm beet salad includes feta cheese and is dressed with a simple herb and shallot vinaigrette. It’s colorful, elegant, and sure to impress!

review.reviewBody: Very, very good! It was way too hot to turn on the oven, so instead I peeled and cubed the beets, mixed together everything except the parsley and feta and wrapped in a double thickness foil pouch - roasted on the grill for about 15 minutes or so, then sprinkled with the parsley and feta. DELICIOUS! And good cold, too, as I'm still picking on the leftovers.
Roasted the beets wrapped in foil in my instant pot on a day too hot for the oven. So easy, no cleanup! I could have eaten at least three servings on my own

Doubled quantities except the red wine vinegar. After peeling and slicing the beets, drizzled with the first 1T Balsamic, 1T OO, and 1T RWV. Roasted at 360° 7 minutes uncovered. Stirred, then drizzled 1T additional Balsamic vinegar. Roasted for another 7 minutes at 360°. The beets absorbed all the liquid. Mixed the last 1T Balsamic and 1T OO with chopped chives and parsley, then added arugula. Used arugula as base for beets on tray. Topped beets with feta and halved gooseberries . Excellent!

I improvised by cooking the beats the day ahead in a pressure cooker for 15 minutes, refrigerated them and peeled easily. I use golden beets, same flavor but no red stains on hands etc. this salad is a summer treat served chilled.

I got beets with greens in my CSA box this week. I boiled the beets until almost done. Peeled and sliced into wedges. Put on the roasting pan with some olive oil , onions, garlic, Roasted until the onions were done, then added the beet greens, the dressing and feta. So yummy! Hubby liked it and he doesn't care much for beets. He does like the golden ones better.

I love beets! Roasted them a day or so prior, peeled and kept in the fridge. I liked the dressing but I add the oil last, drizzling in with an immersion blender to emulsify. You could also do this using a whisk to get a more blended, thicker dressing. I did add a bit more oil and a bit of sugar. I cut the beets into wedges, heated the beets back up, tossed with dressing and placed in small Boston Lettuce cups. I then topped with the cheese, I prefer Goat Cheese but Hubs likes the Feta. Either way, this was good!

Thought I didn't like beets, but these were delicious! I've only had beets once or twice, years ago, and I had never cooked them myself. I picked this recipe because of the great ratings, and it didn't disappoint! To speed things up a bit I peeled and sliced the beets into 1/2 inch wedges, drizzled with a little olive oil, and salt and peppered lightly before roasting at 350 degrees. They were done in 30 minutes. I used onions instead of shallots, but otherwise no changes for the vinaigrette. Wonderful! Wish I remembered to take a picture before we gobbled them up because this recipe makes and elegant, gourmet-looking dish.

Delicious! Lite, fresh, easy appetizer or side. I peeled the beets first then I wrapped them in foil. Mine took longer than an hour but they were delicious even without the cheese. I realized I was out of feta and used goat cheese instead. Delicious!! Will make them again with the feta.
I peeled then cubed the beets (I only had two large ones), tossed them with oil and a bit of garlic then roasted them for about 1/2 hour…left the rest the same…turned out great!

It was complimented by our dinner guests when we served it on a bed of fresh spinach leaves as a starter.
Instead of individually wrapping beets in foil, I toasted them together in a covered roasting pan.
The dressing was just right and didn't overpower the delicate flavour of the beets. Will do this again.

I had some cooked beets I needed to use so I sliced them and warmed them for 1 minute in the microwave. I didn’t have shallots, red wine vinegar or fresh parsley so I skipped the shallots, used apple cider vinegar and used some dried parsley. The dressing poured over warm beets and crumbled feta was so delicious. I crumbled toasted pecans over all. This will become my new favourite salad.
This recipe is a keeper.
Yum!

Just made this tonight for dinner with some beets I roasted the other day. I heated up the beets in a pan to serve how you intended and followed your exact recipe for everything else. This recipe is fantastic! We used feta cheese this time but I think it would be amazing with goat cheese as well. We used pecans because my daughter doesn't like walnuts but it would be great with those as well. My 11 year old had 4 servings! Adding to the rotation. Thank you!
Sooooo good. Worth the effort . Also added walnuts.
I added a tablespoon of honey.
Did not expect the light sweetness
Made the salad for a family gathering. Everyone thoroughly enjoyed the salad. Easy to prepare with fantastic results.
Discovered your recipe a couple of years ago. Absolutely love it. I roast beets like your directions, and pickle them as well:) They are also excellent in this recipe for a little spin. Thank you!
My wife said she could eat this every day! I used red onion, orange slices and chicken chunks (for me) in addition to the original recipe.
